about: Hand-judged statements for tools/decode_eval.py. rows = decoder rows a team should land on (any of them counts as a hit); [] = nonsense control that must return no confident row. row_names pins each referenced row number to the start of its problem-statement cell, so a renumbering fails loudly while appended rows change nothing. split: train statements were used to calibrate DECODE_FLOOR and the matching; holdout statements were written at the same time and not looked at during tuning.

row_names.4: Detect GNSS spoofing on a vehicle
row_names.5: Locate the source of GNSS interference
